items.html: Now we shall explain the reason for Malchut: why she, too, rose up to Daat, above Tifferet. The matter is that Malchut is called “the crown of her husband,” and she rises above Tifferet, especially now, since she had a record from Daat. For when the light of Daat descended to the place of Malchut of Atzilut, at the time her vessel broke as above, it left its record there. And when Malchut reigned in her place, she took this record and rose to the place of Daat itself. There is also another reason: through her ascent there, she binds all of VAK from below upward, and through this bond the correction becomes more complete, since Netzah and Hod were both in the left line, in the place of Gevura, and now Netzah separated from Hod and went up with Hesed in its right line.
